name: pacing_history_weeks
label_en: weeks of history a weekday's weight is read over
label_zh: 星期权重所看的历史周数
explain: the last weeks of the account's own spend by weekday
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: pacing_min_weeks
label_en: occurrences of each weekday needed before weights replace a flat share
label_zh: 用星期权重所需的每个星期几的出现次数
explain: below it every day weighs the same and the plan says flat
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: pacing_explore_min_share
label_en: the least share of a day's budget that goes to exploration
label_zh: 每天预算中至少用于探索的比例
explain: 0 is no floor; practitioners keep testing a minority of spend, mostly 10 to 30 %, and the sources disagree on the figure, so the kit ships none: a month behind its result would otherwise starve exploration to nothing
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: pacing_explore_max_share
label_en: the most a day's budget may put into exploration
label_zh: 每天预算中最多用于探索的比例
explain: 1 is no cap; without one a month ahead of its result puts almost the whole day into exploration; the cap only moves money to performance when there is a proven efficiency to spend it at
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
